questions.question: What was hidden in Benjamin's sack to test the brothers?
options: A heavy bag of pure gold
A sealed letter from the king

questions.question: What did Judah offer in order to save Benjamin?
options: To fight off the Egyptian guards
To remain as a slave in his place
To flee from Egypt with him
To pay a ransom in silver
questions.answer: To remain as a slave in his place

questions.question: The brothers abandoned Benjamin to save themselves.
Joseph's silver cup was found in _____'s sack.
Judah said he could not return to his father if the _____ was not with him.
